title: Leaf Symbol Mistake
alt_text: Repeated leaf symbols crowd the first plant sketch and make openings vanish. A second sketch leaves distinct highlighted gaps between leaves, which can be compared with the real plant.
caption: When gaps close or repeat, compare their shapes with the plant.
